_comment: Written by dragon-dev-buddy:buddy-setup to .dragon-buddy/config.json. Re-run that skill when the project, stack or threat profile changes. Safe to commit EXCEPT the engagement block if it names a client.

project.name: [PROJECT NAME]
project.runtime: [e.g. Cloudflare Workers, Kubernetes, Lambda, bare VM]

security.auth_model: [e.g. OIDC via Auth0, session cookies, mTLS between services]

engagement._comment: Only used by skills that produce exploit code or client-facing reports. Leave empty for ordinary internal work on your own code.
engagement.authorization_ref: [ticket, SOW or written approval this work is covered by]
engagement.contact: [who to notify on a critical finding]

fleet._comment: Only read by the fleet and network skills (change-window, fleet-drift-audit, segmentation-review, device-lifecycle). Leave managed false and the rest empty for an ordinary application repo.
fleet.inventory_source: [e.g. NetBox, Nautobot, an Ansible inventory, a spreadsheet, none]
fleet.config_backup: [e.g. Oxidized, RANCID, NAPALM, a git repo, none]
fleet.golden_config: [path or repo holding the intended config and templates, or none]
fleet.out_of_band: [e.g. console server on a separate carrier, LTE OOB, none]

skill_level: [e.g. senior backend engineer, new to appsec]
